words.description: At most `count` new words that fit the pattern, none of the `seen` words and none of the `examples`. Fewer, or none, is a good answer when no good word is left. The app checks every word against the pattern again and keeps nothing that does not fit.

word.description: One word, lower case, letters only, that shows the pattern.

sentence.description: One plain sentence for a child of the band that uses the word, so its meaning is clear. It never spells the word out, never says how it is spelt and never hints at its spelling.
